hotkeys.description: Customize keyboard shortcuts for vocabulary practice
hotkeys.prevWordDesc: Go to the previous word or sentence in this chapter.
hotkeys.nextWordDesc: Go to the next word or sentence in this chapter.
hotkeys.showWordDesc: Show or hide the target word in fill or dictation mode.
hotkeys.peekWordDesc: Hold to show the word temporarily
hotkeys.favoriteWordDesc: Mark or unmark the current word as familiar.
hotkeys.info: Click a key to change its binding; Esc cancels. Add a modifier to letters or numbers, which are used for typing answers.
hotkeys.wordDeleteDesc: Delete the most recently typed character in fill or dictation mode.
hotkeys.wordSubmitDesc: Check the answer in the dictation input; a correct answer completes this repetition.
hotkeys.sentenceSubmitDesc: In sentence fill mode, confirm the current word; a correct final word completes the sentence.
hotkeys.audioScope: These fixed shortcuts apply in both sentence and full-audio playback. Inputs, dialogs and focused dividers retain their own keyboard behavior.
hotkeys.audioPlayDesc: Play the selected words, or follow the current sentence/full-audio mode when nothing is selected. Press again to pause, then again to resume.
hotkeys.audioPreviousPlayDesc: Go to the previous sentence. The Auto-play toggle below the waveform controls whether playback starts.
hotkeys.audioNextPlayDesc: Go to the next sentence. Playback follows the Auto-play toggle.
hotkeys.audioPreviousSilentDesc: Same as the left arrow. With Auto-play off, change sentences and stay paused.
hotkeys.audioNextSilentDesc: Same as the right arrow. With Auto-play on, play after changing sentences.
hotkeys.audioClearDesc: Stop playback and clear the selected words and track range.
hotkeys.audioExtendDesc: With a word focused, use Shift + Left or Right to move the selection endpoint without switching sentences.
hotkeys.audioSelectionDesc: With a word focused and a selection present, press Enter to play from the start of that selection.
hotkeys.audioCopyDesc: Copy the selected words, or the current sentence when nothing is selected. Text inputs retain normal copy behavior.
hotkeys.audioPanelsDesc: With the vertical divider focused, arrow keys adjust panel widths instead of switching sentences.
hotkeys.audioTrackDesc: With the horizontal divider focused, arrow keys adjust the bottom track height instead of switching sentences.
